name: Premier Inn Bideford
accommodation: Standard double, twin, family, accessible and Premier Plus rooms
suitableFor: Families, couples and those needing accessible rooms
parking: Free on-site parking (register vehicle at reception; no trailers)
confirmedFeatures: Air conditioning, breakfast, free WiFi, accessible rooms
overview: A Premier Inn in Bideford, handy for the harbour, Pannier Market, River Torridge and the Tarka Trail, with Instow beach nearby. Room types include family and accessible rooms, all with air conditioning, and there is free parking on site.
surfTripFit: Free parking and flexible room types make it a straightforward, no-fuss base for driving to Westward Ho!, Saunton or Croyde.
